findings.title: Nil default_locale crashes fallback instead of falling back
findings.body: In config/initializers/i18n.rb FallbackLocaleList#[] does [locale, SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym, :en].uniq.compact. If SiteSetting.default_locale is nil or blank the .to_sym call raises NoMethodError before .compact ever runs, so the compact is dead code. Any missing translation then raises instead of falling back to :en, turning a translation miss into a 500 during setup, migrations, or if the setting is cleared.

findings.title: Translation LRU cache ignores fallback chain
findings.body: In lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb I18n.translate caches with key "#{key}#{config.locale}#{config.backend.object_id}", which omits SiteSetting.default_locale and the fallback list. A miss resolved via fallback (e.g. fr -> de -> en) is cached under the request locale alone. If the admin later changes SiteSetting.default_locale, the cached fallback value is still served until I18n.reload! or process restart, showing the old language.

findings.title: Fallback files only preloaded on web requests
findings.body: In app/controllers/application_controller.rb set_locale calls I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded! to load the user locale, site default, and :en. But lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb I18n.translate only does load_locale(config.locale) for the current locale. Any I18n.t outside a controller request — Sidekiq jobs, mailers, background email rendering, console, rake — never preloads the fallback locales, so a key missing in the current locale returns translation-missing even though it exists in the site default or English.

findings.title: DB lookup on every fallback miss
findings.body: In config/initializers/i18n.rb FallbackLocaleList#[] calls SiteSetting.default_locale on every lookup. The I18n fallback backend calls fallbacks[locale] for every missing key, so every untranslated key does a SiteSetting read in the hot translation path instead of using a cached value, adding Redis/DB overhead to pages with many missing keys.
